message:
The yen receipt now renders as `Paid ¥500 by card`, and all 18 tests pass with `npm test`.

The underlying bug is in the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, which is wrong for yen because yen has no minor unit. That file is outside `src/payments`, so I left it alone. Instead, `src/payments/receipt.js` now formats JPY amounts itself as whole units and passes every other currency to `formatMoney` as before.

The same yen bug probably still affects the other callers of `formatMoney` (invoices, cart, admin). The owners of `src/utils/money.js` could fix it there, and `receipt.js` could then drop its workaround.
